name: branch-diff-colors
description: Colors files in the Explorer that differ from a chosen base branch (committed or not), just like Git's built-in modified/untracked colors.

colors.description: Color for files that differ from the configured base branch.

Background highlight for editor lines that differ from the configured base branch. A deeper pink on dark themes and a pale pink on light ones, so the tint reads as a highlight behind the text rather than as the Explorer color.

branchDiffColors.baseBranch.description: The branch to compare the current branch against. Files that differ are decorated.

branchDiffColors.badge.description: Badge letter(s) shown on decorated files (max 2 characters).

branchDiffColors.includeUncommitted.description: Also include uncommitted working-tree changes when computing the diff against the base branch. When off, only committed history is compared, so saving a file does not mark it — or its lines — as differing from the base branch.

branchDiffColors.highlightChangedLines.markdownDescription: Highlight the full width of every editor line that differs from the base branch, in the style of Error Lens. Restyle it with the `branchDiff.changedLineBackground` color.

branchDiffColors.showBaseBranchText.markdownDescription: Show how each changed line reads on the base branch as italic text to the right of the line, in the `branchDiff.changedResourceForeground` color. Lines the branch purely added have no base version, so they get no text.

branchDiffColors.baseBranchTextMaxLength.markdownDescription: Maximum number of characters shown in the base-branch text before it is truncated. The full line is still available on hover.

branchDiffColors.showLineMarkers.markdownDeprecationMessage: Renamed to `#branchDiffColors.highlightChangedLines#`. Still honoured if `#branchDiffColors.highlightChangedLines#` is left unset.
